title: BwompOnDamage
description: Sound effect(s) that serve no purpose; have fun using them.
body:
A simple mod that plays the 'BWOMP' sound effect from Waterflame's 'Blast Processing' used in Geometry Dash upon taking damage. (More sound effects to come... maybe...)

Yes, that is literally it. Maybe this could create some funny moments. I don't know, go wild.
